R3-OPEN-3 (NEW, AND IT CORRECTS THE ROUND-4 BUILD NOTE'S ACCOUNT OF ITSELF). THE FORAMEN FLOW MARKER CARRIES DIRECTION BUT NOT MAGNITUDE. models3d/fetal-circulation.js:1161-1170 builds the interatrial marker with FIXED extents (-0.30 and +0.34 along nAx, radius 0.15) and takes only the SIGN of F.fo from the solved network - while markerCones() a hundred lines above states the model's own rule, 'WIDTH IS FIXED TO THE VESSEL; LENGTH CARRIES THE FLOW', and implements it as len = radius * (1.80 + 1.60 * min(1, mag/0.60)). MEASURED ON THE BUILT TRIANGLES: the flow_foramen_ovale geometry at t=0.0998 is VERTEX-FOR-VERTEX IDENTICAL to the one at t=0 (apex -0.335,2.359,-0.028 and base -0.048,2.380,-0.121 at both), although the solved interatrial shunt has fallen fourteenfold over that interval, F.fo 0.2600 to 0.0186. CONSEQUENCE: beat 8, 'The flap is pressed shut', draws an interatrial arrow the same size as the fetal one in beat 5 - 1.401 per cent of frame against beat 5's 1.449 - and that arrow is 3.8x the foramen_ovale it passes through (0.371) and the most salient object in the frame. A student reading 'the leaf lies flat because the gradient it hung open on has reversed' is looking at a full-sized arrow driving through the septum. AND IT IS NOT THE PIN: the round-4 build note attributed this to flow_foramen_ovale being pinned @0 and called the fix 'one character', explicitly leaving it as the reviewer's call. I took the call by measuring it - unpinning was walked through the real tool and beat 8 DOES NOT MOVE, 1.401 to 1.401, because the geometry does not depend on t at all. The pin was left alone as harmless and the real fix is in the model: give the foramen marker the magnitude scaling markerCones already has. The residual shunt is genuinely non-zero at that instant (F.fo 0.0186 > FLOW_MARKER_MIN 0.006), so the marker should SHRINK, not vanish.
